question.text: STT on delivery-based SALE of listed equity shares is (rate):

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.3.3, STT on delivery-based sale/purchase of listed equity = 0.1% on transaction value. **The Trap:** 0.001% is for MF unit sales; 0.02% is for sale of futures; 1% is not standard. **Cross-Exam Context:** Common STT on delivery-based equity trades. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** STT is deductible only if income is treated as business income.
